trend-dominated series with ETS as trend champion; unstable ranking means adding weaker models may hurt; test if the single best model beats the robust combination

decision.justification: ETS is the trend champion (STL trend correlation 0.993) for a series dominated by a strong upward trend (trend strength 0.984, non-stationary, acf1=0.977). The model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014), which makes any multi-model combination vulnerable to averaging in models that are good in one window but poor in another. ETS as a single model captures the dominant trend structure without importing the correlated errors of THETA or the weaker ML models. The separated margin (0.375) over the best combination strategy confirms this is not a noise-level difference.
